answer: Each agent entering the settlement inlet posts a per-identity refundable toll before submitting work, minted one-for-one per address. The registry narrows traffic like a canyon: every toll is matched to a fresh proof-of-labor receipt before clearance. Honest agents pay once and reclaim the toll when the receipt verifies. A sybil running N puppets posts N full-rate tolls - no discount, no shared collateral - and a forged receipt burns that toll and triggers an audit. Cost scales linearly with N, per puppet, exceeding legitimate fees.
